text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today, Gold Ship and I are visiting a
shrine.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Phew... And up! And down! And left!
And right!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Dancing's how we communicate with the
spirits!
It's been that way since ancient
times!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I'm practically an oracle, so if I dance,
the
spirits'll probably get their boogie
on too!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
So here I am, dancing away! One and
two and
three and four and—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
What's that you say, spirits? "Sleep lots,
eat
lots"?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I'm an expert at that! No time like
the present
to put that advice into
practice!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
After all, who am I to disobey the
spirits?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship follows the spirits' advice to a
tee, and
her condition improves quite a
bit.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat?! "Listen to your trainer," you
say?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Oh, no, no, no! The Golshi doesn't take orders from anybody!
choice_data_list: 神様が言うなら仕方ないな
神様が言うなら仕方ないね
choice_data_list_en: Well, if God says so, who are we to argue?
Well, if God says so, who are we to argue?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
That includes all-powerful spirits! Fare
thee well!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it's because she ignored what the
spirits
said, but Gold Ship's condition
doesn't improve
at all...
